The new Lamborghini frontier is here.
The power of hybridization technology has

and even more powerful future:
the first-ever HPEV (High-Performance
Electrified Vehicle) ushers in a
brand-new era for the marque, completely
rewriting all paradigms and exalting

innovation by giving the iconic V12
a new life in the modern world.

EXTERIOR DESIGN
A SPACESHIP ON WHEELS
The Revuelto brings Lamborghini’s timeless proportions into a new
age, transferring iconic, instantly recognizable elements onto a
high-tech design whose sculpted lines and smooth negative radiuses
take inspiration from the world of spacecraft to deliver a vehicle
that goes beyond imagination.
Illustrious ancestors such as the Lamborghini Countach live in the
Revuelto through traditional details such as the unique single center line
and the wide, low aspect ratio. Classic lines combine with 3D-sculpted
surfaces to create a dynamic, lightweight structure that embraces the
cockpit and creates tension from the nose of the car to the exhausts
wrapped under the rear wing. The legendary V12 is still the heart
of the machine: on full display at the rear, the engine is a key
element of the design itself.
A further nod to the Lamborghini DNA is found in the rim
designs, which feature trademark elements such as the Y and
hexagon. In addition, the Y-shaped lights with Full LED Lighting
Technology make the Revuelto instantly distinguishable,
even in the dark.
As a whole, the Revuelto exudes a sense of self-confidence,
strength, and power.

pages.text:
INTERIOR DESIGN
FEEL LIKE A PILOT
The interior design of the Revuelto is the highest expression of the
brand’s “Feel Like a Pilot” concept. The driver-focused approach
follows the principles of simple values and symmetry to create an
interior that is entirely in service of the driver, with a cockpit inspired
by fighter jets where all the main commands are clearly visible and
easily accessible.
The elegant environment is characterized by a Y-shaped dashboard design
that connects the driver, passenger, and machine seamlessly. Moreover,
heritage and cutting-edge innovation are again brought together by
exclusive hexagon-shaped elements that evoke Lamborghini models from
the past and highlight functional features. The new steering wheel fully
conveys that “pilot” feeling with an incredibly sleek, sporty look and
integrated rotors and switches to manage the many Driving Modes.
The interior design of the Revuelto follows a philosophy that merges
three main pillars: Essential Driving Experience, Intuitive and Connected,
and Fun-to-Drive. High-quality, luxurious materials, superior Italian
craftsmanship, and endless customization possibilities make the Revuelto
a superb vehicle.

ERGONOMICS & VERSATILIT Y
NEXT-LEVEL COMFORT
The luxurious comfort of the Revuelto is
achieved through improved ergonomics that
create a more spacious cabin and increase
vehicle capacity.
The double bubble roof adds vertical space,
while a more compact central tunnel allows for
more lateral room; vehicle capacity is extended
to the maximum via a back tunnel object
tray and a glove box on the passenger’s side.
The trunk can accommodate up to two cabin
trolleys, while the plain rear bench can store
up to two soft bags. A side skirt embedded in
the door panel eases the entrance and exit.
The Revuelto is designed for maximum
indulgence outside and inside, with enhanced
ergonomics and versatility that rewrite yet
another paradigm.

BRAKE CALIPERS
PERSONALIZE YOUR BRAKES
The Lamborghini Revuelto is equipped
with regenerative braking that increases
the charging power of the HV battery –
the regenerative effect is activated when
pushing down on the brake pedal. The
materials were selected to maximize the
effectiveness of the Revuelto’s braking
system: carbon ceramic discs ensure
improved braking performance, higher
resistance to wear, and a substantial
weight reduction.
While the Standard offer for brake calipers
is Matt Nero Anodizzato, there are further
personalization options in Optional (Nero
Opaco, Rosso, Arancio, Giallo, Verde, Grigio,
Nero Lucido, Verde Chiaro)
and Ad Personam (Verde Scandal).

NEW RIMS DESIGNS
The Revuelto introduces three new rim designs that pay
homage to the Lamborghini heritage with iconic elements
such as the Y and the hexagon.
The Venancio rim is 20” - 21” and made of fused aluminum.
Available in Shiny Silver in the Standard offer, Matt Titanium in
the Optional offer, and Shiny Black in the Ad Personam program.
Altanero is another Optional rim for the Revuelto. It is produced
with advanced technologies that make it possible to shape
the rim more complexly and give it an incredibly resistant
and light structure. The 21” - 22” rim becomes available
for a super sports car for the first time in Lamborghini history.
This Optional rim comes in Shiny Black, diamond-finished
Shiny Black, and diamond-finished Bronze.
The Triguero rim is available in 20” - 21” with a different cut.
It comes in Matt Black, Matt Bronze, Shiny Silver,
and Matt Titanium.
Make your Revuelto truly yours,all the way down to the wheels.

pages.text:
ENGINE
A NEW LIFE FOR THE ICONIC V12
The legendary V12 engine is reborn within the Revuelto
to coexist harmoniously with three electric motors, all
of which have different roles in improving performance
and optimizing weight reduction.
The V12 has been rotated by 180˚ and has undergone a full-on
revolution to bring it into the new Lamborghini era: the engine
features a new, more efficient combustion system, a new exhaust
system that reduces backpressure at high revs, a new intake
system with improved runner fluid dynamics for torque
and power, an improved oil and water system,
and a valve train with new HLA radius tappet for high speed.
Combined with the e-motors, the new V12 can produce a maximum
power of 1015 HP for a top speed of 350 km/h. The highest
performance is also achieved through the 8-gear dual-clutch
system installed transversally behind the engine that drives
the vehicle’s hybrid potential.
The first of its kind, the Revuelto truly is a triumph
of hybridization technology.

pages.text:
E-MOTORS
THE NEW LAMBORGHINI FRONTIER
The Revuelto represents the entrance
of Lamborghini into the future.
The three e-motors play a central role
in making this extraordinary vehicle
technical masterpiece.
The front axle features two e-motors whose
primary functions are torque vectoring,
regenerative braking, and providing an
electric boost with a peak power of over
140 kW. In addition, the front e-axle
is designed to optimize balance and reduce
the weight-to-power ratio to increase
performance levels.
The rear e-motor is mounted right behind
the V12 engine and functions as a starter
for the engine itself and a generator to
recharge batteries. It also drains energy
toward the front axle and provides additional
torque input based on driving modes.

pages.text:
CHASSIS
INSPIRED BY AERONAUTICS
Everything about the Revuelto is revolutionary.
The chassis is entirely new and takes the concept
of carbon fiber monocoque to a whole new level by
extending its application to the front end, creating
a monofuselage inspired by aeronautics.
This solution maximizes weight reduction
(-9 kg vs. Aventador front frame), tensional stiffness
(> 40.000 NM/˚), and strength to protect the vehicle
and its occupants in case of an accident.
Lamborghini’s commitment to sustainability
is expressed in every aspect of the
Revuelto. This vehicle is the first
supersports car with a front structure
of 100% CFRP (Carbon Fiber-Reinforced
Plastic) and elements in Forged
Composites, a more sustainable technology
that generates lower carbon fiber scrap and
requires less energy and water consumption.

AERODYNAMICS
360˚ AERODYNAMICS The futuristic design of the Revuelto is not inspired by
spacecraft in terms of aesthetics only but also in terms of
aerodynamic functionality. To rewrite the DNA of the vehicle
to reach maximum aerodynamic performance, Lamborghini
identified four essential pillars: Efficiency, Components
Synergy, Integration, and Design Inspiration. As a result,
specially designed car body features come together to serve
aerodynamics: from the active rear wing to the maximization
of downforce without increasing base drag, everything works in
complete, harmonious unity.
Something quite unique to the Revuelto is the integration of
the concepts of brake cooling within the aerodynamic
efficiency strategy: the front cooling uses the flow
channelized in the wheelhouse, while rear cooling
harnesses the high energy flow from the
underbody.

LDVI SYSTEM
PREDICT YOUR GROUND
The Lamborghini Integrated Vehicle Dynamics (LDVI)
was also tweaked and improved for the Revuelto. The 2.0
version is more advanced and efficient, able to manage the
torque not only on the single wheel but also when it comes
to the lateral and longitudinal distribution, thanks to a
more dynamic traction control logic that can adapt to the
specific behaviors of each wheel during both acceleration
and braking.
An even more striking feature of the LDVI 2.0 is its predictive
quality; the system can anticipate terrain grip and adapts
acceleration and braking power distribution to guarantee the
best performance and control.
Thanks to the upgraded LDVI, there is no limit to the
adrenaline-filled experiences that the Revuelto can offer.

DRIVING MODES
THE EMOTIONS OF A LIFETIME
The Revuelto features a triumph of driving
modes to explore: thirteen unique combinations
based on the active intersection between the V12
engine and the e-motors. The driver can select a
blend between a Driving Mode and a Hybrid Mode
directly through the rotors on the steering wheel
and be swept away in the driving emotions of a
lifetime.
All available options help to best adapt to all driving
conditions and are divided into four main categories:
Città (for everyday use, 0 emissions, fully electric,
4WD electric on demand), Strada (for daily usability
and transfers mainly on highways, guarantees
comfort and smoothness), Sport (for reactiveness
and fun-to-drive, hills and mountain roads), Corsa (for
track sessions, guarantees high-end performance).
Explore all possible combinations and let the
Revuelto take you on a drive beyond your
imagination.

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
WHEN DESIGN FOLLOWS TECHNOLOGY
In the Revuelto, design follows technology and vice versa. The implemented design
philosophy for interior technology is built on three main pillars:
• Essential Driving Experience, grouping all important information and features,
from the instrument cluster to the rotors on the steering wheel.
• Intuitive & Connected, grouping all content related to infotainment applications,
car settings, and connectivity management.
• Enhanced Fun-to-Drive groups all specific features, animations, dynamic widgets,
and sport chrono. These are all features that enhance the fun-to-drive experience
for all occupants.
Explore the innovative technology of the Revuelto and enhance your driving experience.
